title: Measuring Language Transfer in Robot Policies: Adding Greek to a Cosmos3 Vision-Language-Action Policy
abstract: arXiv:2609.07470v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Robot foundation models are trained and evaluated predominantly in English, and robot demonstration corpora do not exist for most languages. We study the addition of Greek to an open vision-language-action stack using only machine-rephrased instructions and no architecture changes. The main challenge is measurement rather than translation. Several plausible instruments produce false conclusions: a color-histogram metric rewards noise, a single-goal benchmark scores 84.6% under correct Greek and 82.6% under deliberately wrong instructions, training loss fails to predict Greek success, and single-run comparisons are dominated by seed variation. On a discriminative ninety-task suite with three seeds per arm, a multilingual text tower without Greek demonstrations remains at its wrong-instruction floor, while Greek-only training exceeds its control by at most 2.7 points. translated_title: 测量机器人策略中的语言迁移：将希腊语加入Cosmos3视觉-语言-动作策略
translated_abstract: 机器人基础模型主要以英语进行训练和评估，而大多数语言并不存在机器人演示语料库。我们研究了在一个开放的视觉-语言-动作系统中加入希腊语，仅使用机器改写的指令，且不进行任何架构改动。主要挑战在于测量而非翻译。若干看似合理的评估工具会得出错误的结论：颜色直方图指标会奖励噪声，单一目标基准在正确希腊语指令下得分为84.6%，而在故意错误的指令下得分为82.6%，训练损失无法预测希腊语的成功，且单次运行的比较被随机种子变化所主导。在一个具有区分性的九十任务评估套件上（每组三个随机种子），没有希腊语演示的多语言文本塔仍停留在其错误指令的水平下限，而仅希腊语训练最多比其对照组高出2.7分。双语训练则相比其对照组取得6.7至7.1分的稳定优势……
tldr: 该研究将机器改写的希腊语指令加入Cosmos3视觉-语言-动作机器人策略，指出语言迁移的主要挑战是评估测量而非翻译本身——多种常见评估指标会得出虚假结论——并构建区分性九十任务基准证明双语训练可带来6.7至7.1分的稳定提升。
en_tdlr: By adding machine-rephrased Greek instructions to a Cosmos3 vision-language-action robot policy without architecture changes, this work reveals that the main challenge of language transfer is measurement rather than translation, exposes misleading evaluation metrics, and shows through a discriminative ninety-task benchmark that bilingual training yields a consistent 6.7–7.1 point improvement.
